State approves Rs 750 crore police modernisation

The state government has approved a Rs 750 crore police modernisation programme covering cyber forensic laboratories, modern weaponry, mobility and training infrastructure over three years.

Under the plan, cyber labs will come up in all nine police ranges, while district forces will receive new vehicles, body-worn cameras and upgraded control rooms.

Officials said a dedicated budget line has been created so that procurement does not stall for want of annual sanctions.

Police associations welcomed the move but sought simultaneous recruitment to fill nearly 20,000 vacancies in the force.

The home department will review utilisation every quarter, officials added.
